Start a project version

Source: R/initialize_project.R
initialize_project.Rd

initialize_project() sets the paths of a project version and sources its functions folder. It MUST be the first call in every vNN_run.R.

Usage

initialize_project(version, home, data_raw, env = .GlobalEnv)

Arguments

version

The version, written as "v" and two digits, for example "v01".

home

The project folder. It holds <version>_run.R and <version>_functions/.

data_raw

The folder of the real raw data, one string. The folder MAY be absent, for example on a computer without the real data. Only save_results() for the scenario "real" then stops.

env

The environment that the functions folder is sourced into.

Value

Invisibly, a list with version, home, results and data_raw. results is the results folder.

Details

initialize_project() does these steps in this order:

  1. It computes the md5 of <version>_run.R and of each file in <version>_functions/, before it sources them. save_results() stores them in manifest$source_md5.

  2. It computes the md5 of each file directly in data_raw, when the folder exists. save_results() stores them in manifest$data_md5 of the scenario "real". A file that the run writes later is not in the list.

  3. It calls org::initialize_project() with folders_to_be_sourced set to <version>_functions, max_loc_per_file set to 1000 and data_raw set to data_raw. A data function finds the folder at org::project$data_raw.

The results folder is <home>/<version>_results. save_results() creates it. initialize_project() creates no folder, also no folder with today's date. It stops when <version>_functions/ does not exist.

initialize_project() reads no scenario, no simulation, no command-line argument and no environment variable, and it sets no seed. scenarios() chooses the scenarios, and add_data() and add_analyses() set the seeds.

See also

vignette("pbn"), which builds and runs a small fake project.

Other project setup: end_unless_real(), scenarios()

Examples

home <- file.path(tempdir(), "pbn_initialize_example")
dir.create(file.path(home, "v01_functions"), recursive = TRUE)
writeLines(
  "CFG <- list(scenarios = data.frame(scenario = c('real', 'null'), sims = c(1, 3)))",
  file.path(home, "v01_functions", "_cfg.R")
)

env <- new.env()
p <- pbn::initialize_project(
  version = "v01",
  home = home,
  data_raw = file.path(home, "data"),
  env = env
)
#> You are NOT sourcing into .GlobalEnv. All functions will be sourced into an environment that is returned from this function.
#> Sourcing all code inside /tmp/RtmpbNywL7/pbn_initialize_example/v01_functions into 
p$results
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpbNywL7/pbn_initialize_example/v01_results"
env$CFG$scenarios
#>   scenario sims
#> 1     real    1
#> 2     null    3

unlink(home, recursive = TRUE)
